info.title: jaravi-mcp 0.12.0 — deterministic orchestration of external CLI sub-agents.
info.description: Jaravi MCP server: deterministic orchestration of external CLI sub-agents (OpenCode, Claude Code, Copilot…) with context-collapse protection. MCP over stdio or HTTP + WebSocket telemetry for the Jaravi Dashboard.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription:
Jaravi runs coding agents (OpenCode, Codex, Claude Code, Gemini, Copilot…)
as sub-agents and returns bounded results instead of raw output. Drive it
from a shell with the commands below, or from an MCP client over --stdio.

options.name: --input-from
options.description:
Seed this task with a finished session's result.
The engine injects a bounded excerpt, so the
intermediate output never reaches you.

options.name: --claims
options.description: Paths this run owns; a conflicting spawn is refused.

options.name: --on-conflict
options.description: Refuse, or park until the conflict clears.
